newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 266 mln of 2-yr and 5-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 266 mln of 2-yr and 5-yr bonds.

text.p: Poland sold 226 million zlotys of 15 percent two-year bonds and 40 million of 12 percent five year bonds after investors bid for 249 and 357 million zlotys worth of the bonds respectively, the finance ministry said.
The treasury's joint offer was 800 million zlotys.
The minimum price of the shorter, 15 percent bonds was cut to 90.21 from 90.60 at the last auction on February 5, 1997, while the average price fell 0.33 point to 90.40.
The treasury raised the minimum price of the longer, 12 percent bonds by 0.11 point to 79.41, but the average price fell to 79.47 from 79.61.
